records.source: Clint is taking sips from an unmarked flask.
records.translation: Humihigop si Clint mula sa isang praskong walang tatak.

records.source: Hey... that was kind of fun... right?$h
records.translation: Hoy... medyo masaya iyon... hindi ba?$h

records.source: I ate a handful of nuts to prepare for this movie... brain food!
records.translation: Kumain ako ng isang dakot na mani bilang paghahanda sa pelikulang ito... pagkain para sa utak!

records.source: I feel a little bit smarter than I was before... don't you?
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay medyo mas matalino ako kaysa dati... ikaw rin ba?

records.source: When I saw the movie poster for this one, I felt a very positive sensation in the top of my head.$h
records.translation: Nang makita ko ang poster ng pelikulang ito, nakadama ako ng napakapositibong sensasyon sa tuktok ng ulo ko.$h

records.source: That movie felt very spiritual, in a way... don't you agree? I loved it!$h
records.translation: May pagkaespirituwal ang dating ng pelikulang iyon... sang-ayon ka ba? Gustong-gusto ko iyon!$h

records.source: I'm happy to see a movie with you! I tend to get totally lost in the screen.
records.translation: Masaya akong manood ng pelikula kasama ka! Madalas akong lubos na nadadala sa pinanonood ko.

records.source: I feel positive after that one... that means it was a good movie!$h
records.translation: Positibo ang pakiramdam ko matapos iyon... ibig sabihin, maganda ang pelikula!$h

records.source: I usually go to more positive movies, so this will be interesting.
records.translation: Karaniwan ay mas positibong mga pelikula ang pinanonood ko, kaya magiging kawili-wili ito.

records.source: Yoba, please protect me from the dark energy of this movie.$7
records.translation: Yoba, ipagsanggalang mo sana ako sa madilim na enerhiya ng pelikulang ito.$7

records.source: Emily is whispering to herself...
records.translation: Pabulong na kinakausap ni Emily ang sarili niya...

records.source: My energy levels are low after that one...$3
records.translation: Mababa ang antas ng enerhiya ko matapos iyon...$3

records.source: Mmm... It's nice and warm in here. Winter is my favorite time to go to the movies.$h
records.translation: Mmm... Mainit-init at komportable rito. Paborito kong panahon ang taglamig para manood ng pelikula.$h

records.source: That was very romantic.
records.translation: Napakaromantiko niyon.

records.source: Mmm... It's nice and warm in here. Winter is my favorite time to go to the movies.$h
records.translation: Mmm... Mainit-init at komportable rito. Paborito kong panahon ang taglamig para manood ng pelikula.$h

records.source: I'm glad there was a good ending!
records.translation: Natutuwa akong maganda ang wakas!

records.source: Oh, is this one of those 'fantasy' movies?$7
records.translation: Oh, isa ba ito sa mga pelikulang 'pantasya'?$7

records.source: *yawn*... What? Oh... what was that movie about, again?$7
records.translation: *hikab*... Ano? Oh... tungkol saan nga ulit ang pelikulang iyon?$7

records.source: Everyone's talking about this movie, so I've been wanting to see it.
records.translation: Pinag-uusapan ng lahat ang pelikulang ito, kaya gusto ko na itong mapanood.

records.source: That last scene... what did they mean by that?
records.translation: Ang huling tagpong iyon... ano ang ibig nilang sabihin doon?

records.source: Hey, @! I'm looking forward to this one... I hope we learn a lot!$h
records.translation: Hoy, @! Sabik na ako rito... Sana ay marami tayong matutuhan!$h

records.source: Ah, I see... that's very interesting!
records.translation: Ah, nauunawaan ko... talagang kawili-wili iyan!

records.source: Maru's taking notes!
records.translation: Nagtatala si Maru!

records.source: That was really interesting! I had no idea that so much life could be found in the big city.
records.translation: Talagang kawili-wili iyon! Hindi ko alam na napakaraming uri ng buhay ang matatagpuan sa malaking lungsod.

records.source: It's a sci-fi movie, right? One of the things I like about sci-fi is seeing all the weird technologies they come up with.
records.translation: Pelikulang agham-piksiyon ito, hindi ba? Isa sa mga gusto ko sa agham-piksiyon ang makita ang lahat ng kakaibang teknolohiyang naiisip nila.

records.source: Well, I've never seen anything like *that* through my telescope... but it was really great!$h
records.translation: Hindi pa ako nakakita ng anumang gaya *niyon* sa teleskopyo ko... pero napakaganda talaga!$h

records.source: I really like going to the theater, even if the movie's bad!$h
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong pumunta sa sinehan kahit pangit ang pelikula!$h

records.source: That was an interesting choice, for the final scene. What do you think they meant by that?
records.translation: Kawili-wili ang pinili nila para sa huling tagpo. Ano sa palagay mo ang ibig nilang sabihin doon?

records.source: Hey. I heard this movie is pretty grim... I'm looking forward to it.$h
records.translation: Hoy. Nabalitaan kong medyo malagim ang pelikulang ito... Sabik na ako.$h

records.source: This cinematography is next-level.
records.translation: Ibang antas ang sinematograpiya nito.
